root_text: Did you know? 🤔 HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a common yet often overlooked respiratory virus. It can affect people of all ages, but children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems are at higher risk. 🦠 https://t.co/Cs3Uiou

nodes.author: Thenewscreater
nodes.text: Symptoms mimic a cold or flu: cough, fever, and nasal congestion—but in severe cases, it can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia. 😷Protect yourself by practicing good hygiene: wash hands regularly, avoid close contact with sick individuals, and disinfect surfaces.Stay informed.
